title: Unit test owner-session-env times out at 30 s under full parallel load
description: conversation/test/owner-session-env.test.ts ('reaches the tools of an owner that is given one and is absent for an owner that is not') passed alone in 3 s but exceeded 30 s in the full vitest run on two occasions (PR 490 and PR 499 local runs). Find the slow setup (moto round trips) and cut it; do not raise the timeout.
right_now_summary: The owner-session-env test times out under full parallel load due to slow moto setup calls.
